text: In American Sign Language, even a small brow movement can help shape a question. Inflect gives you a focused space to watch, try, and review.
Start with one cue. Raised brows, furrowed brows, or changing between the two. Watch the guide first, and notice where the movement returns to rest.
Then choose how you want to practise. A camera mirror for self review, a clearly labelled walkthrough, or live movement feedback in the desktop app.
Live feedback starts with your consent. Enter your private key locally. Inflect keeps it in memory for this session.
On the tested Windows build, Presage supplied these actual face landmarks, with the brows highlighted in the live view.
Personal calibration compares a relaxed brow, a comfortable lift, and a gentle furrow. Those positions give Inflect a reference for your movements.
This labelled walkthrough shows the same twenty second cue schedule. Keep the movement comfortable, and follow the guide.
After practice, look at the timing. This real live session review shows matching movement in both cues, and how much tracking was usable.
These observations describe brow movement. They do not grade your signing, or fill in missing measurements.
Your summary stays on this device. Open My sessions to export a result, or clear your history when you choose.
No camera video is saved. Landmarks and calibration stay in memory, and S D K telemetry is off.
Inflect. Let your face ask the question. Built by unborn.
